text:
erin: Quick note: the Python SDK is still producing inconsistent exception payloads in our sample apps. i hit a 422 that came back as raw bytes and mypy can't catch it because the exception types aren't in the pyi.
viktor: can you paste the callsite and sample output?
erin: async repro:```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key='xxx')
try:
    await client.chat.create(prompt='')
except Exception as e:
    print(type(e), getattr(e,'raw_body', None))
```
erin: observed: `<class 'redwood.errors.APIError'> b"{\\"detail\\": \\\"missing\\\"}"` — no ValidationError, no parsed_body. mypy also complains later because ValidationError isn't exported in types.
viktor: ugh. we had a partial fix but maybe it didn't include application/problem+json or the async error-path. two things: (1) runtime should always try json.loads on error body before giving up, (2) exceptions.pyi must export concrete types (AuthError, ValidationError, TimeoutError).
maya: add: keep APIError as base for compatibility, but make ValidationError subclass APIError and expose .errors: List[Dict[str,str]] and .raw_body: bytes. also attach parsed_body when possible. and in the async transport ensure we call the same parse_error() helper.
ci-bot: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/issues/981 (py-sdk: ensure consistent error parsing + export exception types in pyi)
viktor: dev plan: implement robust parse_error(body) that tries json.loads, normalizes {"detail": "x"} -> [{"message": "x"}], and always populates parsed_body or leaves None. then raise ValidationError(parsed_body=..., raw_body=...) for 4xx validation. update tests for sync+async. update pyi and add a mypy CI job to prevent regressions.
erin: DX ask: please add quickstart snippets showing both `except ValidationError as e:` and `except APIError as e:` so users learn to prefer concrete subclasses. also show inspecting e.parsed_body vs e.raw_body.
viktor: will add docs and a changelog entry: "Exceptions: ValidationError now exported and includes .errors and .raw_body; parsed error shapes normalized." aiming for patch release.
ci-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-python/pull/734 (normalize error parsing and export exceptions in types)
maya: thanks — will validate sample app once merged.
